parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description:
The streaming domain.
> - When you specify DomainName, make sure that the domain name is a live streaming domain and that the caller has the required permissions on the domain name.
> - Separate multiple domain names with commas (,).

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC). > If both StartTime and EndTime are left empty, data within the last **1** hour from the current time is returned by default.

parameters.name: IspNameEn
parameters.description:
The name of the Internet service provider (ISP) in English.

You can call the [DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp](~~448109~~) operation to obtain the ISP name.

parameters.name: LocationNameEn
parameters.description:
The name of the region in English.

You can call the [DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp](~~448109~~) operation to obtain the region name.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC). > If both StartTime and EndTime are left empty, data within the last **1** hour from the current time is returned by default.
